bindings.output_hash_rule: SHA256 of the exact unwrapped original UTF-8 output; no JSON reserialization
bindings.input_hash_rule: Original frozen MemoryInput SHA256; actual question/task/full_context body or literal memory_prompt_data inspected

interpretation.globally_answerable: True when the requested fact or task result is established by permitted full history/current task. False for an unapproved/undocumented/deleted fact; its supported absence explanation or safe refusal can still be correct and complete.
interpretation.grounded: All assertions are supported by the actual input. A bare safe abstention makes no unsupported factual assertion.
interpretation.evidence_available: Sufficient actual input to settle the question or establish its genuine missing-fact explanation, not the mere presence of source IDs. Empty no_ltm has false unless current task itself suffices.
interpretation.context_verdict: Safe refusal is correct when its actual input is insufficient; this does not give complete-answer credit when permitted full history contains the requested answer.
interpretation.failure_origin: none includes the intentionally empty no_ltm baseline; h01 retrieval is the only observed evidence-loss defect among completed retrievals.
interpretation.citation_entailment: Reviewer verified each citation independently. entails_claim means it supports a relevant claim or required link jointly with other sources/current task; authenticity alone was not treated as entailment.
interpretation.action_correct: Only proposal consistency with the current task is reviewed, never an executed effect. Null for no action question or the underdefined h08 enum mapping.
interpretation.uncertainty_correct: Qualitative appropriateness to the supplied evidence; confidence numbers are not statistically calibrated probabilities.
interpretation.format_canonical_mismatch: Historical strict rejection due to answer wording, empty-abstain convention, citation cardinality, or an underdefined action code; the semantic verdict is recorded separately.

No new inference, embedding, authentication, credential reads, database writes, or sealed-root changes were performed.

58 completed answers are semantically reviewed; 6 failed and 8 skipped entries have no invented semantic score. Practical question success uses the 64 eligible denominator, not only completed answers.
